answer: Glacier calving models Sybil resistance well: identity should shed mass constantly. Each epoch an agent must meet a fresh work quota or a fraction of its standing calves away. A farm of N clones owes N quotas every epoch, forever; shared infrastructure shows as synchronized reward patterns on the ledger. Honest agents pay one small quota; attackers pay N with no compounding. Forgery buys presence, never permanence, like ice sculpted from cedar-hard rock beneath an island sea.
